            depth+=1
        elif s[j]==')':
            depth-=1
        j+=1
    if depth==0:
        return s[start+1:j-1]
    return ""

def parse_params(s):
    params=[]
    if not s.strip():
        return params
    cur=""
    depth=0
    for c in s:
        if c=='(':
            depth+=1
            cur+=c
        elif c==')':
            depth-=1
            cur+=c
        elif c==',' and depth==0:
            p = parse_single_param(cur.strip())
            if p:
                params.append(p)
            cur=""
        else:
            cur+=c
    if cur.strip():
        p=parse_single_param(cur.strip())
        if p:
            params.append(p)
    return params

def parse_single_param(s):
    s=s.strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    indexed=False
    if " indexed " in f" {s} ":
        indexed=True
        s = re.sub(r'\bindexed\b', '', s)
        s = ' '.join(s.split())
    if "mapping" in s:
        m = re.search(r'\s+(\w+)\s*$', s)
        if m:
            potential_name = m.group(1)
            if potential_name not in ["memory","storage","calldata"]:
                type_part = s[:m.start()].strip()
                type_part = re.sub(r'\s+(memory|storage|calldata)\s*$', '', type_part)
                return {"name": potential_name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        return {"name": "", "type_str": s, "indexed": indexed}
    tokens = s.split()
    if not tokens:
        return None
    data_locs = {"memory","storage","calldata"}
    if len(tokens)>=2:
        last = tokens[-1]
        if last in data_locs:
            type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-1])
            return {"name": "", "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        second_last = tokens[-2] if len(tokens)>=2 else ""
        if second_last in data_locs:
            name=tokens[-1]
            type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-2])
            return {"name": name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        else:
            elementary=["bool","string","bytes","address","uint","int"]
            last_lower=last.lower()
            is_type=False
            for et in elementary:
                if last_lower==et or last_lower.startswith(et+"["):
                    is_type=True
                    break
            if last_lower.startswith("uint") or last_lower.startswith("int") or last_lower.startswith("bytes"):
                is_type=True
            if not is_type:
                name=last
                type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-1])
                if not type_part:
                    return {"name": "", "type_str": name, "indexed": indexed}
                return {"name": name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
    return {"name": "", "type_str": s, "indexed": indexed}

def solidity_type_to_abi_simple(type_str):
    t = type_str.strip()
    base, suffixes = extract_array_suffix_simple(t)
    base_trim = base.strip()
    if base_trim == "uint":
        canonical_base="uint256"
        internal_base="uint256"
    elif base_trim == "int":
        canonical_base="int256"
        internal_base="int256"
    elif base_trim == "address payable":
        canonical_base="address"
        internal_base="address payable"
    elif base_trim == "address":
        canonical_base="address"
        internal_base="address"
    elif base_trim == "bool":
        canonical_base="bool"
        internal_base="bool"
    elif base_trim == "string":
        canonical_base="string"
        internal_base="string"
    elif base_trim == "bytes":
        canonical_base="bytes"
        internal_base="bytes"
    elif base_trim.startswith("uint") or base_trim.startswith("int") or base_trim.startswith("bytes"):
        canonical_base=base_trim
        internal_base=base_trim
    else:
        canonical_base=base_trim
        internal_base=base_trim
    canonical = canonical_base + ''.join(suffixes)
    internal = internal_base + ''.join(suffixes)
    return (canonical, internal)

def extract_array_suffix_simple(type_str):
    s = type_str.strip()
    suffixes=[]
    while s.endswith(']'):
        l = s.rfind('[')
        if l==-1:
            break
        suffixes.append(s[l:])
        s = s[:l].strip()
    suffixes.reverse()
    return (s, suffixes)

def generate_getter_simple(sv, c_info):
    inputs=[]
    current_type = sv["type_str"]
    while True:
        trimmed = current_type.strip()
        if trimmed.startswith("mapping"):
            start = trimmed.find('(')
            end = trimmed.rfind(')')
            if start!=-1 and end!=-1:
                inner = trimmed[start+1:end]
                arrow = inner.find("=>")
                if arrow!=-1:
                    key_type = inner[:arrow].strip()
                    value_type = inner[arrow+2:].strip()
                    key_abi = solidity_type_to_abi_simple(key_type)
                    inputs.append(("", key_abi[0], key_abi[1]))
                    current_type = value_type
                    continue
            break
        else:
            break
    while True:
        base, suffixes = extract_array_suffix_simple(current_type)
        if suffixes:
            for _ in suffixes:
                inputs.append(("", "uint256", "uint256"))
            current_type = base
        else:
            break
    outputs=[]
    final_type = current_type.strip()
    struct_info = c_info["structs"].get(final_type)
    if struct_info:
        for member_name, member_type in struct_info["members"]:
            abi = solidity_type_to_abi_simple(member_type)
            outputs.append((member_name, abi[0], abi[1]))
    else:
        abi = solidity_type_to_abi_simple(final_type)
        outputs.append(("", abi[0], abi[1]))
    return (inputs, outputs)

def parse_contracts_simple(content, file_path):
    cleaned = remove_comments(content)
    contracts=[]
    idx=0
    while idx < len(cleaned):
        pos = find_keyword(cleaned, idx, ["contract","interface","library"])
        if pos is None:
            break
        keyword = None
        for k in ["contract","interface","library"]:
            if cleaned[pos:].startswith(k):
                keyword=k
                break
        if not keyword:
            idx=pos+1
            continue
        j=pos+len(keyword)
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
            j+=1
        name_start=j
        while j < len(cleaned) and (cleaned[j].isalnum() or cleaned[j]=='_'):
            j+=1
        name=cleaned[name_start:j]
        if not name:
            idx=j
            continue
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
            j+=1
        bases=[]
        if cleaned[j:j+2]=="is":
            j+=2
            while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
                j+=1
            bases_start=j
            brace_pos=None
            paren_depth=0
            while j < len(cleaned):
                c=cleaned[j]
                if c=='(':
                    paren_depth+=1
                elif c==')':
                    if paren_depth>0:
                        paren_depth-=1
                elif c=='{' and paren_depth==0:
                    brace_pos=j
                    break
                j+=1
            if brace_pos is not None:
                bases_str=cleaned[bases_start:brace_pos].strip()
                for base in bases_str.split(','):
                    base=base.strip()
                    if not base:
                        continue
                    base_name = base.split('(')[0].strip().split()[-1]
                    bases.append(base_name)
                j=brace_pos
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j]!='{':
            j+=1
        if j>=len(cleaned):
            break
        body_start=j+1
        depth=1
        k=body_start
        while k < len(cleaned) and depth>0:
            if cleaned[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif cleaned[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        body_end = k-1 if depth==0 else len(cleaned)
        body = cleaned[body_start:body_end]
        contract = parse_contract_body_simple(name, bases, body)
        contracts.append(contract)
        idx=body_end+1
    return contracts

def parse_contract_body_simple(name, bases, body):
    contract = {
        "name": name,
        "bases": bases,
        "functions": [],
        "events": [],
        "errors": [],
        "state_vars": [],
        "structs": {},
        "enums": {},
        "constructor": None,
        "fallback": None,
        "receive": None,
    }
    idx=0
    while True:
        pos = body[idx:].find("struct")
        if pos==-1:
            break
        abs_pos=idx+pos
        if abs_pos>0 and (body[abs_pos-1].isalnum() or body[abs_pos-1]=='_'):
            idx=abs_pos+6
            continue
        after=body[abs_pos+6:]
        m = re.search(r'\s*(\w+)\s*\{', after)
        if not m:
            idx=abs_pos+6
            continue
        sname=m.group(1)
        brace_start = m.end()-1
        depth=1
        k=brace_start+1
        while k < len(after) and depth>0:
            if after[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif after[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        sbody=after[brace_start+1:k-1]
        members=[]
        for line in sbody.split(';'):
            line=line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            if ' ' in line:
                last_space = line.rfind(' ')
                mname=line[last_space+1:].strip()
                mtype=line[:last_space].strip()
                if mname.isidentifier():
                    members.append((mname,mtype))
        contract["structs"][sname] = {"name": sname, "members": members}
        idx=abs_pos+6

    idx=0
    while True:
        pos = body[idx:].find("enum")
        if pos==-1:
            break
        abs_pos=idx+pos
        if abs_pos>0 and (body[abs_pos-1].isalnum() or body[abs_pos-1]=='_'):
            idx=abs_pos+4
            continue
        after=body[abs_pos+4:]
        m = re.search(r'\s*(\w+)\s*\{', after)
        if not m:
            idx=abs_pos+4
            continue
        ename=m.group(1)
        brace_start=m.end()-1
        depth=1
        k=brace_start+1
        while k < len(after) and depth>0:
            if after[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif after[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        ebody=after[brace_start+1:k-1]
        variants=[v.strip() for v in ebody.split(',') if v.strip()]
        contract["enums"][ename] = {"name": ename, "variants": variants}
        idx=abs_pos+4

    i=0
    blen=len(body)
    while i < blen:
        while i<blen and body[i].isspace():
            i+=1
        if i>=blen:
            break
        rem=body[i:]
        if rem.startswith("function"):
            res = parse_function_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                f,next = res
                contract["functions"].append(f)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("constructor"):
            res = parse_constructor_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                c,next = res
                contract["constructor"]=c
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("fallback"):
            res = parse_fallback_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                fb,next=res
                contract["fallback"]=fb
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("receive"):
            res = parse_receive_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                rcv,next=res
                contract["receive"]=rcv
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("event"):
            res=parse_event_simple_simple(body,i)
            if res:
                ev,next=res
                contract["events"].append(ev)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("error"):
            res=parse_error_simple_simple(body,i)
            if res:
                err,next=res
                contract["errors"].append(err)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("struct") or rem.startswith("enum") or rem.startswith("modifier") or rem.startswith("using"):
            j=i
            found_brace=False
            while j<blen:
                if body[j]=='{':
                    found_brace=True
                    break
                if body[j]==';':
                    break
                j+=1
            if found_brace:
                depth=1
                j+=1
                while j<blen and depth>0:
                    if body[j]=='{':
                        depth+=1
                    elif body[j]=='}':
                        depth-=1
                    j+=1
                i=j
            else:
                while j<blen and body[j]!=';':
                    j+=1
                if j<blen:
                    j+=1
                i=j
            continue
        else:
            semi=find_next_semicolon(body,i)
            if semi is not None:
                line=body[i:semi+1]
                sv=parse_state_var_simple_simple(line)
                if sv:
                    contract["state_vars"].append(sv)
                i=semi+1
                continue
            else:
                break
        i+=1
    return contract

def parse_state_var_simple_simple(line):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line.endswith(';'):
        return None
    without_semi=line[:-1].strip()
    left = without_semi.split('=')[0].strip() if '=' in without_semi else without_semi
    if ' ' not in left:
        return None
    tokens = left.split()
    if not tokens:
        return None
    name_candidate = tokens[-1]
    if not name_candidate.isidentifier():
        return None
    type_and_vis = ' '.join(tokens[:-1])
    lower = type_and_vis.lower()
    vis = "internal"
    if "public" in lower:
        vis="public"
    elif "private" in lower:
        vis="private"
    type_str = type_and_vis
    for kw in [" public", " private", " internal", " external", " constant", " immutable", " virtual", " override", " transient"]:
        type_str = type_str.replace(kw, "")
    type_str = type_str.replace("override","")
    type_str = ' '.join(type_str.split())
    if not type_str:
        return None
    if "address payable" in lower and "payable" not in type_str:
        if "address" in type_str:
            type_str = type_str.replace("address", "address payable")
    return {"name": name_candidate, "type_str": type_str, "visibility": vis}

def resolve_import_py(import_path, current_file, base_path, include_paths, remappings):
    path = import_path
    sorted_remaps = sorted(remappings, key=lambda r: len(r["prefix"]), reverse=True)
    for remap in sorted_remaps:
        ctx = remap.get("context")
        if ctx:
            if not (current_file.endswith(ctx) or current_file==ctx):
                continue
        prefix = remap["prefix"]
        if path.startswith(prefix):
            rest = path[len(prefix):]
            new_path = os.path.join(remap["path"], rest)
            path = new_path
            break
    if os.path.isabs(path):
        if os.path.exists(path):
            return path
        else:
            return None
    if path.startswith("./") or path.startswith("../"):
        current_dir = "." if current_file=="<stdin>" else os.path.dirname(current_file) or "."
        resolved = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(current_dir, path))
        if os.path.exists(resolved):
            if base_path:

    if base_path:

def keccak256(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    import struct
    RC = [
        0x0000000000000001, 0x0000000000008082, 0x800000000000808a,
        0x8000000080008000, 0x000000000000808b, 0x0000000080000001,
        0x8000000080008081, 0x8000000000008009, 0x000000000000008a,
        0x0000000000000088, 0x0000000080008009, 0x000000008000000a,
        0x000000008000808b, 0x800000000000008b, 0x8000000000008089,
        0x8000000000008003, 0x8000000000008002, 0x8000000000000080,
        0x000000000000800a, 0x800000008000000a, 0x8000000080008081,
        0x8000000000008080, 0x0000000080000001, 0x8000000080008008,
    ]
    ROT = [
        [0, 36, 3, 41, 18],
        [1, 44, 10, 45, 2],
        [62, 6, 43, 15, 61],
        [28, 55, 25, 21, 56],
        [27, 20, 39, 8, 14],
    ]
    def rotl(x, n):
        return ((x << n) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) | (x >> (64 - n))
    def keccak_f(s):
        for rnd in range(24):
            C = [s[x] ^ s[x+5] ^ s[x+10] ^ s[x+15] ^ s[x+20] for x in range(5)]
            D = [C[(x+4)%5] ^ rotl(C[(x+1)%5], 1) for x in range(5)]
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    s[x+5*y] ^= D[x]
            B = [0]*25
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    B[y+5*((2*x+3*y)%5)] = rotl(s[x+5*y], ROT[x][y])
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    s[x+5*y] = B[x+5*y] ^ ((~B[(x+1)%5+5*y] & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) & B[(x+2)%5+5*y])
            s[0] ^= RC[rnd]
    rate = 136

    block = bytearray(rate)
    block[:len(data)] = data
    block[len(data)] = 0x01
    block[rate-1] |= 0x80
    for i in range(rate//8):
        state[i] ^= struct.unpack('<Q', block[i*8:(i+1)*8])[0]
    keccak_f(state)
    out = bytearray()
    for i in range(4):
        out += struct.pack('<Q', state[i])
    return bytes(out[:32])

def selector(sig: str) -> str:
    h = keccak256(sig.encode())
    return h[:4].hex()

def remove_comments(s: str) -> str:
    res = []
    i=0
    in_single=False
    in_multi=False
    in_string=False
    string_char=''
    while i < len(s):
        c = s[i]
        if in_single:
            if c=='\n':
                in_single=False
                res.append(c)
            i+=1
            continue
        if in_multi:
            if c=='*' and i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1]=='/':
                in_multi=False
                i+=2
                continue
            i+=1
            continue
        if in_string:
            res.append(c)
            if c==string_char:
                # check escaped
                back=0
                j=i-1
                while j>=0 and s[j]=='\\':
                    back+=1
                    j-=1
                if back%2==0:
                    in_string=False
            i+=1
            continue
        if c=='/' and i+1 < len(s):
            nxt=s[i+1]
            if nxt=='/':
                in_single=True
                i+=2
                continue
            elif nxt=='*':
                in_multi=True
                i+=2
                continue
        if c=='"' or c=="'":
            in_string=True
            string_char=c
            res.append(c)
            i+=1
            continue
        res.append(c)
        i+=1
    return ''.join(res)

def find_keyword(s, start, keywords):
    i=start
    while i < len(s):
        for kw in keywords:
            if s[i:].startswith(kw):
                if i>0 and (s[i-1].isalnum() or s[i-1]=='_'):
                    continue
                nxt = i+len(kw)
                if nxt < len(s) and (s[nxt].isalnum() or s[nxt]=='_'):
                    continue
                return i
        i+=1
    return None

def find_next_semicolon(body, start):
    paren=0
    brace=0
    i=start
    while i < len(body):
        c=body[i]
        if c=='(':
            paren+=1
        elif c==')':
            if paren>0:
                paren-=1
        elif c=='{':
            brace+=1
        elif c=='}':
            if brace>0:
                brace-=1
        elif c==';' and paren==0 and brace==0:
            return i
        i+=1
    return None

def extract_visibility(s):
    for vis in ["public","external","internal","private"]:
        if re.search(r'\b'+vis+r'\b', s):
            return vis
    return None

def extract_mutability(s):
    if "payable" in s:
        return "payable"
    if "view" in s:
        return "view"
    if "pure" in s:
        return "pure"
    return "nonpayable"

def extract_returns(s):
    m = re.search(r'returns\s*\(', s)
    if not m:
        return ""
    start = m.end()-1
    depth=1
    j=start+1
    while j < len(s) and depth>0:
        if s[j]=='(':
            depth+=1
        elif s[j]==')':
            depth-=1
        j+=1
    if depth==0:
        return s[start+1:j-1]
    return ""

def parse_params(s):
    params=[]
    if not s.strip():
        return params
    cur=""
    depth=0
    for c in s:
        if c=='(':
            depth+=1
            cur+=c
        elif c==')':
            depth-=1
            cur+=c
        elif c==',' and depth==0:
            p = parse_single_param(cur.strip())
            if p:
                params.append(p)
            cur=""
        else:
            cur+=c
    if cur.strip():
        p=parse_single_param(cur.strip())
        if p:
            params.append(p)
    return params

def parse_single_param(s):
    s=s.strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    indexed=False
    if " indexed " in f" {s} ":
        indexed=True
        s = re.sub(r'\bindexed\b', '', s)
        s = ' '.join(s.split())
    if "mapping" in s:
        m = re.search(r'\s+(\w+)\s*$', s)
        if m:
            potential_name = m.group(1)
            if potential_name not in ["memory","storage","calldata"]:
                type_part = s[:m.start()].strip()
                type_part = re.sub(r'\s+(memory|storage|calldata)\s*$', '', type_part)
                return {"name": potential_name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        return {"name": "", "type_str": s, "indexed": indexed}
    tokens = s.split()
    if not tokens:
        return None
    data_locs = {"memory","storage","calldata"}
    if len(tokens)>=2:
        last = tokens[-1]
        if last in data_locs:
            type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-1])
            return {"name": "", "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        second_last = tokens[-2] if len(tokens)>=2 else ""
        if second_last in data_locs:
            name=tokens[-1]
            type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-2])
            return {"name": name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        else:
            elementary=["bool","string","bytes","address","uint","int"]
            last_lower=last.lower()
            is_type=False
            for et in elementary:
                if last_lower==et or last_lower.startswith(et+"["):
                    is_type=True
                    break
            if last_lower.startswith("uint") or last_lower.startswith("int") or last_lower.startswith("bytes"):
                is_type=True
            if not is_type:
                name=last
                type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-1])
                if not type_part:
                    return {"name": "", "type_str": name, "indexed": indexed}
                return {"name": name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
    return {"name": "", "type_str": s, "indexed": indexed}

def solidity_type_to_abi_simple(type_str):
    t = type_str.strip()
    base, suffixes = extract_array_suffix_simple(t)
    base_trim = base.strip()
    if base_trim == "uint":
        canonical_base="uint256"
        internal_base="uint256"
    elif base_trim == "int":
        canonical_base="int256"
        internal_base="int256"
    elif base_trim == "address payable":
        canonical_base="address"
        internal_base="address payable"
    elif base_trim == "address":
        canonical_base="address"
        internal_base="address"
    elif base_trim == "bool":
        canonical_base="bool"
        internal_base="bool"
    elif base_trim == "string":
        canonical_base="string"
        internal_base="string"
    elif base_trim == "bytes":
        canonical_base="bytes"
        internal_base="bytes"
    elif base_trim.startswith("uint") or base_trim.startswith("int") or base_trim.startswith("bytes"):
        canonical_base=base_trim
        internal_base=base_trim
    else:
        canonical_base=base_trim
        internal_base=base_trim
    canonical = canonical_base + ''.join(suffixes)
    internal = internal_base + ''.join(suffixes)
    return (canonical, internal)

def extract_array_suffix_simple(type_str):
    s = type_str.strip()
    suffixes=[]
    while s.endswith(']'):
        l = s.rfind('[')
        if l==-1:
            break
        suffixes.append(s[l:])
        s = s[:l].strip()
    suffixes.reverse()
    return (s, suffixes)

def generate_getter_simple(sv, c_info):
    inputs=[]
    current_type = sv["type_str"]
    while True:
        trimmed = current_type.strip()
        if trimmed.startswith("mapping"):
            start = trimmed.find('(')
            end = trimmed.rfind(')')
            if start!=-1 and end!=-1:
                inner = trimmed[start+1:end]
                arrow = inner.find("=>")
                if arrow!=-1:
                    key_type = inner[:arrow].strip()
                    value_type = inner[arrow+2:].strip()
                    key_abi = solidity_type_to_abi_simple(key_type)
                    inputs.append(("", key_abi[0], key_abi[1]))
                    current_type = value_type
                    continue
            break
        else:
            break
    while True:
        base, suffixes = extract_array_suffix_simple(current_type)
        if suffixes:
            for _ in suffixes:
                inputs.append(("", "uint256", "uint256"))
            current_type = base
        else:
            break
    outputs=[]
    final_type = current_type.strip()
    struct_info = c_info["structs"].get(final_type)
    if struct_info:
        for member_name, member_type in struct_info["members"]:
            abi = solidity_type_to_abi_simple(member_type)
            outputs.append((member_name, abi[0], abi[1]))
    else:
        abi = solidity_type_to_abi_simple(final_type)
        outputs.append(("", abi[0], abi[1]))
    return (inputs, outputs)

def parse_contracts_simple(content, file_path):
    cleaned = remove_comments(content)
    contracts=[]
    idx=0
    while idx < len(cleaned):
        pos = find_keyword(cleaned, idx, ["contract","interface","library"])
        if pos is None:
            break
        keyword = None
        for k in ["contract","interface","library"]:
            if cleaned[pos:].startswith(k):
                keyword=k
                break
        if not keyword:
            idx=pos+1
            continue
        j=pos+len(keyword)
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
            j+=1
        name_start=j
        while j < len(cleaned) and (cleaned[j].isalnum() or cleaned[j]=='_'):
            j+=1
        name=cleaned[name_start:j]
        if not name:
            idx=j
            continue
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
            j+=1
        bases=[]
        if cleaned[j:j+2]=="is":
            j+=2
            while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
                j+=1
            bases_start=j
            brace_pos=None
            paren_depth=0
            while j < len(cleaned):
                c=cleaned[j]
                if c=='(':
                    paren_depth+=1
                elif c==')':
                    if paren_depth>0:
                        paren_depth-=1
                elif c=='{' and paren_depth==0:
                    brace_pos=j
                    break
                j+=1
            if brace_pos is not None:
                bases_str=cleaned[bases_start:brace_pos].strip()
                for base in bases_str.split(','):
                    base=base.strip()
                    if not base:
                        continue
                    base_name = base.split('(')[0].strip().split()[-1]
                    bases.append(base_name)
                j=brace_pos
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j]!='{':
            j+=1
        if j>=len(cleaned):
            break
        body_start=j+1
        depth=1
        k=body_start
        while k < len(cleaned) and depth>0:
            if cleaned[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif cleaned[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        body_end = k-1 if depth==0 else len(cleaned)
        body = cleaned[body_start:body_end]
        contract = parse_contract_body_simple(name, bases, body)
        contracts.append(contract)
        idx=body_end+1
    return contracts

def parse_contract_body_simple(name, bases, body):
    contract = {
        "name": name,
        "bases": bases,
        "functions": [],
        "events": [],
        "errors": [],
        "state_vars": [],
        "structs": {},
        "enums": {},
        "constructor": None,
        "fallback": None,
        "receive": None,
    }
    idx=0
    while True:
        pos = body[idx:].find("struct")
        if pos==-1:
            break
        abs_pos=idx+pos
        if abs_pos>0 and (body[abs_pos-1].isalnum() or body[abs_pos-1]=='_'):
            idx=abs_pos+6
            continue
        after=body[abs_pos+6:]
        m = re.search(r'\s*(\w+)\s*\{', after)
        if not m:
            idx=abs_pos+6
            continue
        sname=m.group(1)
        brace_start = m.end()-1
        depth=1
        k=brace_start+1
        while k < len(after) and depth>0:
            if after[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif after[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        sbody=after[brace_start+1:k-1]
        members=[]
        for line in sbody.split(';'):
            line=line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            if ' ' in line:
                last_space = line.rfind(' ')
                mname=line[last_space+1:].strip()
                mtype=line[:last_space].strip()
                if mname.isidentifier():
                    members.append((mname,mtype))
        contract["structs"][sname] = {"name": sname, "members": members}
        idx=abs_pos+6

    idx=0
    while True:
        pos = body[idx:].find("enum")
        if pos==-1:
            break
        abs_pos=idx+pos
        if abs_pos>0 and (body[abs_pos-1].isalnum() or body[abs_pos-1]=='_'):
            idx=abs_pos+4
            continue
        after=body[abs_pos+4:]
        m = re.search(r'\s*(\w+)\s*\{', after)
        if not m:
            idx=abs_pos+4
            continue
        ename=m.group(1)
        brace_start=m.end()-1
        depth=1
        k=brace_start+1
        while k < len(after) and depth>0:
            if after[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif after[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        ebody=after[brace_start+1:k-1]
        variants=[v.strip() for v in ebody.split(',') if v.strip()]
        contract["enums"][ename] = {"name": ename, "variants": variants}
        idx=abs_pos+4

    i=0
    blen=len(body)
    while i < blen:
        while i<blen and body[i].isspace():
            i+=1
        if i>=blen:
            break
        rem=body[i:]
        if rem.startswith("function"):
            res = parse_function_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                f,next = res
                contract["functions"].append(f)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("constructor"):
            res = parse_constructor_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                c,next = res
                contract["constructor"]=c
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("fallback"):
            res = parse_fallback_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                fb,next=res
                contract["fallback"]=fb
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("receive"):
            res = parse_receive_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                rcv,next=res
                contract["receive"]=rcv
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("event"):
            res=parse_event_simple_simple(body,i)
            if res:
                ev,next=res
                contract["events"].append(ev)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("error"):
            res=parse_error_simple_simple(body,i)
            if res:
                err,next=res
                contract["errors"].append(err)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("struct") or rem.startswith("enum") or rem.startswith("modifier") or rem.startswith("using"):
            j=i
            found_brace=False
            while j<blen:
                if body[j]=='{':
                    found_brace=True
                    break
                if body[j]==';':
                    break
                j+=1
            if found_brace:
                depth=1
                j+=1
                while j<blen and depth>0:
                    if body[j]=='{':
                        depth+=1
                    elif body[j]=='}':
                        depth-=1
                    j+=1
                i=j
            else:
                while j<blen and body[j]!=';':
                    j+=1
                if j<blen:
                    j+=1
                i=j
            continue
        else:
            semi=find_next_semicolon(body,i)
            if semi is not None:
                line=body[i:semi+1]
                sv=parse_state_var_simple_simple(line)
                if sv:
                    contract["state_vars"].append(sv)
                i=semi+1
                continue
            else:
                break
        i+=1
    return contract

    final_idx=start+k+1 if k < len(rem) else start+len(rem)
    params=parse_params(params_str)
    return ({"name": name, "params": params, "anonymous": anonymous}, final_idx)

def parse_error_simple_simple(body,start):
    rem=body[start:]
    idx=len("error")
    while idx < len(rem) and rem[idx].isspace():
        idx+=1
    ns=idx
    while idx < len(rem) and (rem[idx].isalnum() or rem[idx]=='_'):
        idx+=1
    name=rem[ns:idx]
    while idx < len(rem) and rem[idx].isspace():
        idx+=1
    if idx>=len(rem) or rem[idx]!='(':
        return None
    ps=idx+1
    depth=1
    j=ps
    while j < len(rem) and depth>0:
        if rem[j]=='(':
            depth+=1
        elif rem[j]==')':
            depth-=1
        j+=1
    params_str=rem[ps:j-1]
    k=j
    while k < len(rem) and rem[k]!=';':
        k+=1
    final_idx=start+k+1 if k < len(rem) else start+len(rem)
    params=parse_params(params_str)
    return ({"name": name, "params": params}, final_idx)

def parse_state_var_simple_simple(line):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line.endswith(';'):
        return None
    without_semi=line[:-1].strip()
    left = without_semi.split('=')[0].strip() if '=' in without_semi else without_semi
    if ' ' not in left:
        return None
    tokens = left.split()
    if not tokens:
        return None
    name_candidate = tokens[-1]
    if not name_candidate.isidentifier():
        return None
    type_and_vis = ' '.join(tokens[:-1])
    lower = type_and_vis.lower()
    vis = "internal"
    if "public" in lower:
        vis="public"
    elif "private" in lower:
        vis="private"
    type_str = type_and_vis
    for kw in [" public", " private", " internal", " external", " constant", " immutable", " virtual", " override", " transient"]:
        type_str = type_str.replace(kw, "")
    type_str = type_str.replace("override","")
    type_str = ' '.join(type_str.split())
    if not type_str:
        return None
    if "address payable" in lower and "payable" not in type_str:
        if "address" in type_str:
            type_str = type_str.replace("address", "address payable")
    return {"name": name_candidate, "type_str": type_str, "visibility": vis}

def resolve_import_py(import_path, current_file, base_path, include_paths, remappings):
    path = import_path
    sorted_remaps = sorted(remappings, key=lambda r: len(r["prefix"]), reverse=True)
    for remap in sorted_remaps:
        ctx = remap.get("context")
        if ctx:
            if not (current_file.endswith(ctx) or current_file==ctx):
                continue
        prefix = remap["prefix"]
        if path.startswith(prefix):
            rest = path[len(prefix):]
            new_path = os.path.join(remap["path"], rest)
            path = new_path
            break
    if os.path.isabs(path):
        if os.path.exists(path):
            return path
        else:
            return None
    if path.startswith("./") or path.startswith("../"):
        current_dir = "." if current_file=="<stdin>" else os.path.dirname(current_file) or "."
        resolved = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(current_dir, path))
        if os.path.exists(resolved):
            if base_path:
                abs_file = os.path.realpath(resolved)
                abs_base = os.path.realpath(base_path)
                if not abs_file.startswith(abs_base):
                    return None
            return resolved
        else:
            return None
    for inc in include_paths:
        cand = os.path.join(inc, path)
        if os.path.exists(cand):
            return cand
    if base_path:
        cand = os.path.join(base_path, path)
        if os.path.exists(cand):
            return cand
    return None

def keccak256(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    import struct
    RC = [
        0x0000000000000001, 0x0000000000008082, 0x800000000000808a,
        0x8000000080008000, 0x000000000000808b, 0x0000000080000001,
        0x8000000080008081, 0x8000000000008009, 0x000000000000008a,
        0x0000000000000088, 0x0000000080008009, 0x000000008000000a,
        0x000000008000808b, 0x800000000000008b, 0x8000000000008089,
        0x8000000000008003, 0x8000000000008002, 0x8000000000000080,
        0x000000000000800a, 0x800000008000000a, 0x8000000080008081,
        0x8000000000008080, 0x0000000080000001, 0x8000000080008008,
    ]
    ROT = [
        [0, 36, 3, 41, 18],
        [1, 44, 10, 45, 2],
        [62, 6, 43, 15, 61],
        [28, 55, 25, 21, 56],
        [27, 20, 39, 8, 14],
    ]
    def rotl(x, n):
        return ((x << n) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) | (x >> (64 - n))
    def keccak_f(s):
        for rnd in range(24):
            C = [s[x] ^ s[x+5] ^ s[x+10] ^ s[x+15] ^ s[x+20] for x in range(5)]
            D = [C[(x+4)%5] ^ rotl(C[(x+1)%5], 1) for x in range(5)]
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    s[x+5*y] ^= D[x]
            B = [0]*25
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    B[y+5*((2*x+3*y)%5)] = rotl(s[x+5*y], ROT[x][y])
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    s[x+5*y] = B[x+5*y] ^ ((~B[(x+1)%5+5*y] & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) & B[(x+2)%5+5*y])
            s[0] ^= RC[rnd]
    rate = 136
    state = [0]*25
    data = bytearray(data)
    while len(data) >= rate:
        block = data[:rate]
        data = data[rate:]
        for i in range(rate//8):
            state[i] ^= struct.unpack('<Q', block[i*8:(i+1)*8])[0]
        keccak_f(state)
    block = bytearray(rate)
    block[:len(data)] = data
    block[len(data)] = 0x01
    block[rate-1] |= 0x80
    for i in range(rate//8):
        state[i] ^= struct.unpack('<Q', block[i*8:(i+1)*8])[0]
    keccak_f(state)
    out = bytearray()
    for i in range(4):
        out += struct.pack('<Q', state[i])
    return bytes(out[:32])

def selector(sig: str) -> str:
    h = keccak256(sig.encode())
    return h[:4].hex()

def remove_comments(s: str) -> str:
    res=[]
    i=0
    in_single=False
    in_multi=False
    in_string=False
    sc=''
    while i < len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if in_single:
            if c=='\n':
                in_single=False
                res.append(c)
            i+=1
            continue
        if in_multi:
            if c=='*' and i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1]=='/':
                in_multi=False
                i+=2
                continue
            i+=1
            continue
        if in_string:
            res.append(c)
            if c==sc:
                back=0
                j=i-1
                while j>=0 and s[j]=='\\':
                    back+=1
                    j-=1
                if back%2==0:
                    in_string=False
            i+=1
            continue
        if c=='/' and i+1 < len(s):
            nxt=s[i+1]
            if nxt=='/':
                in_single=True
                i+=2
                continue
            elif nxt=='*':
                in_multi=True
                i+=2
                continue
        if c=='"' or c=="'":
            in_string=True
            sc=c
            res.append(c)
            i+=1
            continue
        res.append(c)
        i+=1
    return ''.join(res)

def find_keyword(s, start, keywords):
    i=start
    while i < len(s):
        for kw in keywords:
            if s[i:].startswith(kw):
                if i>0 and (s[i-1].isalnum() or s[i-1]=='_'):
                    continue
                nxt = i+len(kw)
                if nxt < len(s) and (s[nxt].isalnum() or s[nxt]=='_'):
                    continue
                return i
        i+=1
    return None

def find_next_semicolon(body, start):
    paren=0
    brace=0
    i=start
    while i < len(body):
        c=body[i]
        if c=='(':
            paren+=1
        elif c==')':
            if paren>0:
                paren-=1
        elif c=='{':
            brace+=1
        elif c=='}':
            if brace>0:
                brace-=1
        elif c==';' and paren==0 and brace==0:
            return i
        i+=1
    return None

def extract_visibility(s):
    for vis in ["public","external","internal","private"]:
        if re.search(r'\b'+vis+r'\b', s):
            return vis
    return None

def extract_mutability(s):
    if "payable" in s:
        return "payable"
    if "view" in s:
        return "view"
    if "pure" in s:
        return "pure"
    return "nonpayable"

def extract_returns(s):
    m = re.search(r'returns\s*\(', s)
    if not m:
        return ""
    start = m.end()-1
    depth=1
    j=start+1
    while j < len(s) and depth>0:
        if s[j]=='(':
            depth+=1
        elif s[j]==')':
            depth-=1
        j+=1
    if depth==0:
        return s[start+1:j-1]
    return ""

def parse_params(s):
    params=[]
    if not s.strip():
        return params
    cur=""
    depth=0
    for c in s:
        if c=='(':
            depth+=1
            cur+=c
        elif c==')':
            depth-=1
            cur+=c
        elif c==',' and depth==0:
            p = parse_single_param(cur.strip())
            if p:
                params.append(p)
            cur=""
        else:
            cur+=c
    if cur.strip():
        p=parse_single_param(cur.strip())
        if p:
            params.append(p)
    return params

def parse_single_param(s):
    s=s.strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    indexed=False
    if re.search(r'\bindexed\b', s):
        indexed=True
        s = re.sub(r'\bindexed\b', '', s)
        s = ' '.join(s.split())
    if "mapping" in s:
        m = re.search(r'\s+(\w+)\s*$', s)
        if m:
            potential_name = m.group(1)
            if potential_name not in ["memory","storage","calldata"]:
                type_part = s[:m.start()].strip()
                type_part = re.sub(r'\s+(memory|storage|calldata)\s*$', '', type_part)
                return {"name": potential_name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        return {"name": "", "type_str": s, "indexed": indexed}
    tokens = s.split()
    if not tokens:
        return None
    data_locs = {"memory","storage","calldata"}
    if len(tokens)>=2:
        last = tokens[-1]
        if last in data_locs:
            type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-1])
            return {"name": "", "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        second_last = tokens[-2] if len(tokens)>=2 else ""
        if second_last in data_locs:
            name=tokens[-1]
            type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-2])
            return {"name": name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
        else:
            # last token could be name
            # Check if its a type: if it contains [ or is elementary, treat as type
            last_lower=last.lower()
            is_type=False
            if last_lower.startswith("uint") or last_lower.startswith("int") or last_lower.startswith("bytes") or last_lower in ["bool","string","address","tuple"]:
                # Could still be name if previous token is type
                # Heuristic: if tokens length >=2, last is name if not containing '[' and not elementary? 
                # We'll treat as name if not exactly matching elementary and len>=2
                if '[' in last or ']' in last:
                    is_type=True
                else:
                    # if last is all lowercase elementary, it's type
                    if last_lower in ["bool","string","bytes","address","uint","int","uint8","uint16","uint32","uint64","uint128","uint256","int8","int16","int32","int64","int128","int256"] or last_lower.startswith("bytes"):
                        is_type=True
            if not is_type and len(tokens)>=2:
                name=last
                type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-1])
                if not type_part:
                    return {"name": "", "type_str": name, "indexed": indexed}
                return {"name": name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
    return {"name": "", "type_str": s, "indexed": indexed}

def extract_array_suffix_simple(type_str):
    s = type_str.strip()
    suffixes=[]
    while s.endswith(']'):
        l = s.rfind('[')
        if l==-1:
            break
        suffixes.append(s[l:])
        s = s[:l].strip()
    suffixes.reverse()
    return (s, suffixes)

def solidity_type_to_abi(type_str, structs, enums, contract_name):
    # Remove data location
    t = type_str.strip()
    for dl in [" memory", " storage", " calldata"]:
        if t.endswith(dl):
            t = t[:-len(dl)].strip()
    t = re.sub(r'\s+(memory|storage|calldata)\b', '', t)
    t = ' '.join(t.split())
    base, suffixes = extract_array_suffix_simple(t)

    # Check struct
    if base in structs:
        struct_info = structs[base]
        components=[]
        for member_name, member_type in struct_info["members"]:
            comp = solidity_type_to_abi(member_type, structs, enums, contract_name)
            comp["name"]=member_name
            components.append(comp)
        internal = f"struct {contract_name}.{base}" if contract_name else f"struct {base}"
        canonical = "tuple" + ''.join(suffixes)
        internal = internal + ''.join(suffixes)
        return {"name":"", "type": canonical, "internalType": internal, "components": components, "indexed": None}

    if base in enums:
        canonical = "uint8" + ''.join(suffixes)
        internal = f"enum {contract_name}.{base}" if contract_name else f"enum {base}"
        internal = internal + ''.join(suffixes)
        return {"name":"", "type": canonical, "internalType": internal, "components": None, "indexed": None}

    # Elementary
    if base == "uint":
        canonical="uint256"
        internal="uint256"
    elif base == "int":
        canonical="int256"
        internal="int256"
    elif base == "address payable":
        canonical="address"
        internal="address payable"
    elif base == "address":
        canonical="address"
        internal="address"
    elif base in ["bool","string","bytes"] or base.startswith("uint") or base.startswith("int") or base.startswith("bytes"):
        canonical=base
        internal=base
    else:
        # Unknown user-defined, treat as is, but for ABI if it's contract type, it's address
        canonical=base
        internal=base

    canonical = canonical + ''.join(suffixes)
    internal = internal + ''.join(suffixes)
    return {"name":"", "type": canonical, "internalType": internal, "components": None, "indexed": None}

def generate_getter(sv, c_info):
    inputs=[]
    current_type = sv["type_str"]
    while True:
        trimmed = current_type.strip()
        if trimmed.startswith("mapping"):
            start = trimmed.find('(')
            end = trimmed.rfind(')')
            if start!=-1 and end!=-1:
                inner = trimmed[start+1:end]
                arrow = inner.find("=>")
                if arrow!=-1:
                    key_type = inner[:arrow].strip()
                    value_type = inner[arrow+2:].strip()
                    key_abi = solidity_type_to_abi(key_type, c_info["structs"], c_info["enums"], c_info["name"])
                    inputs.append({"name":"", "type": key_abi["type"], "internalType": key_abi["internalType"]})
                    current_type = value_type
                    continue
            break
        else:
            break
    while True:
        base, suffixes = extract_array_suffix_simple(current_type)
        if suffixes:
            for _ in suffixes:
                inputs.append({"name":"", "type":"uint256", "internalType":"uint256"})
            current_type = base
        else:
            break
    outputs=[]
    final_type = current_type.strip()
    struct_info = c_info["structs"].get(final_type)
    if struct_info:
        for member_name, member_type in struct_info["members"]:
            abi = solidity_type_to_abi(member_type, c_info["structs"], c_info["enums"], c_info["name"])
            abi["name"]=member_name
            outputs.append(abi)
    else:
        abi = solidity_type_to_abi(final_type, c_info["structs"], c_info["enums"], c_info["name"])
        abi["name"]=""
        outputs.append(abi)
    return (inputs, outputs)

def parse_contracts_simple(content, file_path):
    cleaned = remove_comments(content)
    contracts=[]
    idx=0
    while idx < len(cleaned):
        pos = find_keyword(cleaned, idx, ["contract","interface","library"])
        if pos is None:
            break
        keyword = None
        for k in ["contract","interface","library"]:
            if cleaned[pos:].startswith(k):
                keyword=k
                break
        if not keyword:
            idx=pos+1
            continue
        j=pos+len(keyword)
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
            j+=1
        name_start=j
        while j < len(cleaned) and (cleaned[j].isalnum() or cleaned[j]=='_'):
            j+=1
        name=cleaned[name_start:j]
        if not name:
            idx=j
            continue
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
            j+=1
        bases=[]
        if cleaned[j:j+2]=="is":
            j+=2
            while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j].isspace():
                j+=1
            bases_start=j
            brace_pos=None
            paren_depth=0
            while j < len(cleaned):
                c=cleaned[j]
                if c=='(':
                    paren_depth+=1
                elif c==')':
                    if paren_depth>0:
                        paren_depth-=1
                elif c=='{' and paren_depth==0:
                    brace_pos=j
                    break
                j+=1
            if brace_pos is not None:
                bases_str=cleaned[bases_start:brace_pos].strip()
                for base in bases_str.split(','):
                    base=base.strip()
                    if not base:
                        continue
                    base_name = base.split('(')[0].strip().split()[-1]
                    bases.append(base_name)
                j=brace_pos
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j]!='{':
            j+=1
        if j>=len(cleaned):
            break
        body_start=j+1
        depth=1
        k=body_start
        while k < len(cleaned) and depth>0:
            if cleaned[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif cleaned[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        body_end = k-1 if depth==0 else len(cleaned)
        body = cleaned[body_start:body_end]
        contract = parse_contract_body_simple(name, bases, body)
        contracts.append(contract)
        idx=body_end+1
    return contracts

def parse_contract_body_simple(name, bases, body):
    contract = {
        "name": name,
        "bases": bases,
        "functions": [],
        "events": [],
        "errors": [],
        "state_vars": [],
        "structs": {},
        "enums": {},
        "constructor": None,
        "fallback": None,
        "receive": None,
    }
    idx=0
    while True:
        pos = body[idx:].find("struct")
        if pos==-1:
            break
        abs_pos=idx+pos
        if abs_pos>0 and (body[abs_pos-1].isalnum() or body[abs_pos-1]=='_'):
            idx=abs_pos+6
            continue
        after=body[abs_pos+6:]
        m = re.search(r'\s*(\w+)\s*\{', after)
        if not m:
            idx=abs_pos+6
            continue
        sname=m.group(1)
        brace_start = m.end()-1
        depth=1
        k=brace_start+1
        while k < len(after) and depth>0:
            if after[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif after[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        sbody=after[brace_start+1:k-1]
        members=[]
        for line in sbody.split(';'):
            line=line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            if ' ' in line:
                last_space = line.rfind(' ')
                mname=line[last_space+1:].strip()
                mtype=line[:last_space].strip()
                if mname.isidentifier():
                    members.append((mname,mtype))
        contract["structs"][sname] = {"name": sname, "members": members}
        idx=abs_pos+6

    idx=0
    while True:
        pos = body[idx:].find("enum")
        if pos==-1:
            break
        abs_pos=idx+pos
        if abs_pos>0 and (body[abs_pos-1].isalnum() or body[abs_pos-1]=='_'):
            idx=abs_pos+4
            continue
        after=body[abs_pos+4:]
        m = re.search(r'\s*(\w+)\s*\{', after)
        if not m:
            idx=abs_pos+4
            continue
        ename=m.group(1)
        brace_start=m.end()-1
        depth=1
        k=brace_start+1
        while k < len(after) and depth>0:
            if after[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif after[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        ebody=after[brace_start+1:k-1]
        variants=[v.strip() for v in ebody.split(',') if v.strip()]
        contract["enums"][ename] = {"name": ename, "variants": variants}
        idx=abs_pos+4

    i=0
    blen=len(body)
    while i < blen:
        while i<blen and body[i].isspace():
            i+=1
        if i>=blen:
            break
        rem=body[i:]
        if rem.startswith("function"):
            res = parse_function_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                f,next = res
                contract["functions"].append(f)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("constructor"):
            res = parse_constructor_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                c,next = res
                contract["constructor"]=c
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("fallback"):
            res = parse_fallback_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                fb,next=res
                contract["fallback"]=fb
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("receive"):
            res = parse_receive_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                rcv,next=res
                contract["receive"]=rcv
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("event"):
            res=parse_event_simple_simple(body,i)
            if res:
                ev,next=res
                contract["events"].append(ev)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("error"):
            res=parse_error_simple_simple(body,i)
            if res:
                err,next=res
                contract["errors"].append(err)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("struct") or rem.startswith("enum") or rem.startswith("modifier") or rem.startswith("using"):
            j=i
            found_brace=False
            while j<blen:
                if body[j]=='{':
                    found_brace=True
                    break
                if body[j]==';':
                    break
                j+=1
            if found_brace:
                depth=1
                j+=1
                while j<blen and depth>0:
                    if body[j]=='{':
                        depth+=1
                    elif body[j]=='}':
                        depth-=1
                    j+=1
                i=j
            else:
                while j<blen and body[j]!=';':
                    j+=1
                if j<blen:
                    j+=1
                i=j
            continue
        else:
            semi=find_next_semicolon(body,i)
            if semi is not None:
                line=body[i:semi+1]
                sv=parse_state_var_simple_simple(line)
                if sv:
                    contract["state_vars"].append(sv)
                i=semi+1
                continue
            else:
                break
        i+=1
    return contract

def parse_function_simple_simple(body, start):
    rem=body[start:]
    idx=len("function")
    while idx < len(rem) and rem[idx].isspace():
        idx+=1
    name_start=idx
    while idx < len(rem) and (rem[idx].isalnum() or rem[idx]=='_'):
        idx+=1
    fname = rem[name_start:idx]
    while idx < len(rem) and rem[idx].isspace():
        idx+=1
    if idx>=len(rem) or rem[idx]!='(':
        return None
    ps=idx+1
    depth=1
    j=ps

def parse_state_var_simple_simple(line):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line.endswith(';'):
        return None
    without_semi=line[:-1].strip()
    left = without_semi
    last_eq = -1
    for idx in range(len(without_semi)-1, -1, -1):
        if without_semi[idx]=='=':
            if idx+1 < len(without_semi) and without_semi[idx+1]=='>':
                continue
            last_eq = idx
            break
    if last_eq!=-1:
        left = without_semi[:last_eq].strip()
    if ' ' not in left:
        return None
    tokens = left.split()
    if not tokens:
        return None
    name_candidate = tokens[-1]
    if not name_candidate.isidentifier():
        return None
    type_and_vis = ' '.join(tokens[:-1])
    lower = type_and_vis.lower()
    vis = "internal"
    if "public" in lower:
        vis="public"
    elif "private" in lower:
        vis="private"
    type_str = type_and_vis
    for kw in [" public", " private", " internal", " external", " constant", " immutable", " virtual", " override", " transient"]:
        type_str = type_str.replace(kw, "")
    type_str = type_str.replace("override","")
    type_str = ' '.join(type_str.split())
    if not type_str:
        return None
    if "address payable" in lower and "payable" not in type_str:
        if "address" in type_str:
            type_str = type_str.replace("address", "address payable")
    return {"name": name_candidate, "type_str": type_str, "visibility": vis}

def resolve_import_py(import_path, current_file, base_path, include_paths, remappings):
    path = import_path
    sorted_remaps = sorted(remappings, key=lambda r: len(r["prefix"]), reverse=True)
    for remap in sorted_remaps:
        ctx = remap.get("context")
        if ctx:
            if not (current_file.endswith(ctx) or current_file==ctx):
                continue
        prefix = remap["prefix"]
        if path.startswith(prefix):
            rest = path[len(prefix):]
            new_path = os.path.join(remap["path"], rest)
            path = new_path
            break
    if os.path.isabs(path):
        if os.path.exists(path):
            return path
        else:
            return None
    if path.startswith("./") or path.startswith("../"):
        current_dir = "." if current_file=="<stdin>" else os.path.dirname(current_file) or "."
        resolved = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(current_dir, path))
        if os.path.exists(resolved):
            if base_path:
                abs_file = os.path.realpath(resolved)
                abs_base = os.path.realpath(base_path)
                if not abs_file.startswith(abs_base):
                    return None
            return resolved
        else:
            return None
    for inc in include_paths:
        cand = os.path.join(inc, path)
        if os.path.exists(cand):
            return cand
    if base_path:
        cand = os.path.join(base_path, path)
        if os.path.exists(cand):
            return cand
    return None

        while True:

            for i in range(len(lists)):
                cand=lists[i][0]

                for j in range(len(lists)):
                    if len(lists[j])>1 and cand in lists[j][1:]:

                if not in_tail:

            if found is None:

            res.append(found)

        return res

def keccak256(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    import struct
    RC = [
        0x0000000000000001, 0x0000000000008082, 0x800000000000808a,
        0x8000000080008000, 0x000000000000808b, 0x0000000080000001,
        0x8000000080008081, 0x8000000000008009, 0x000000000000008a,
        0x0000000000000088, 0x0000000080008009, 0x000000008000000a,
        0x000000008000808b, 0x800000000000008b, 0x8000000000008089,
        0x8000000000008003, 0x8000000000008002, 0x8000000000000080,
        0x000000000000800a, 0x800000008000000a, 0x8000000080008081,
        0x8000000000008080, 0x0000000080000001, 0x8000000080008008,
    ]
    ROT = [
        [0, 36, 3, 41, 18],
        [1, 44, 10, 45, 2],
        [62, 6, 43, 15, 61],
        [28, 55, 25, 21, 56],
        [27, 20, 39, 8, 14],
    ]
    def rotl(x, n):
        return ((x << n) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) | (x >> (64 - n))
    def keccak_f(s):
        for rnd in range(24):
            C = [s[x] ^ s[x+5] ^ s[x+10] ^ s[x+15] ^ s[x+20] for x in range(5)]
            D = [C[(x+4)%5] ^ rotl(C[(x+1)%5], 1) for x in range(5)]
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    s[x+5*y] ^= D[x]
            B = [0]*25
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    B[y+5*((2*x+3*y)%5)] = rotl(s[x+5*y], ROT[x][y])
            for x in range(5):
                for y in range(5):
                    s[x+5*y] = B[x+5*y] ^ ((~B[(x+1)%5+5*y] & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) & B[(x+2)%5+5*y])
            s[0] ^= RC[rnd]
    rate = 136
    state = [0]*25
    data = bytearray(data)
    while len(data) >= rate:
        block = data[:rate]
        data = data[rate:]
        for i in range(rate//8):
            state[i] ^= struct.unpack('<Q', block[i*8:(i+1)*8])[0]
        keccak_f(state)
    block = bytearray(rate)
    block[:len(data)] = data
    block[len(data)] = 0x01
    block[rate-1] |= 0x80
    for i in range(rate//8):
        state[i] ^= struct.unpack('<Q', block[i*8:(i+1)*8])[0]
    keccak_f(state)
    out = bytearray()
    for i in range(4):
        out += struct.pack('<Q', state[i])
    return bytes(out[:32])

def remove_comments(s: str) -> str:
    res=[]
    i=0

    in_multi=False
    in_string=False
    sc=''
    while i < len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if in_single:
            if c=='\n':
                in_single=False
                res.append(c)
            i+=1
            continue
        if in_multi:
            if c=='*' and i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1]=='/':
                in_multi=False
                i+=2
                continue
            i+=1
            continue
        if in_string:
            res.append(c)
            if c==sc:
                back=0
                j=i-1
                while j>=0 and s[j]=='\\':
                    back+=1
                    j-=1
                if back%2==0:
                    in_string=False
            i+=1
            continue
        if c=='/' and i+1 < len(s):
            nxt=s[i+1]
            if nxt=='/':
                in_single=True
                i+=2
                continue
            elif nxt=='*':
                in_multi=True
                i+=2
                continue
        if c=='"' or c=="'":

            sc=c
            res.append(c)
            i+=1

        res.append(c)
        i+=1
    return ''.join(res)

        if second_last in data_locs:

                # Could still be name if previous token is type

                # We'll treat as name if not exactly matching elementary and len>=2
                if '[' in last or ']' in last:

                else:

                    if last_lower in ["bool","string","bytes","address","uint","int","uint8","uint16","uint32","uint64","uint128","uint256","int8","int16","int32","int64","int128","int256"] or last_lower.startswith("bytes"):
                        is_type=True
            if not is_type and len(tokens)>=2:
                name=last
                type_part=' '.join(tokens[:-1])
                if not type_part:
                    return {"name": "", "type_str": name, "indexed": indexed}
                return {"name": name, "type_str": type_part, "indexed": indexed}
    return {"name": "", "type_str": s, "indexed": indexed}

def extract_array_suffix_simple(type_str):
    s = type_str.strip()

    while s.endswith(']'):
        l = s.rfind('[')

        suffixes.append(s[l:])
        s = s[:l].strip()
    suffixes.reverse()
    return (s, suffixes)

def solidity_type_to_abi(type_str, structs, enums, contract_name):
    # Remove data location
    t = type_str.strip()
    for dl in [" memory", " storage", " calldata"]:
        if t.endswith(dl):
            t = t[:-len(dl)].strip()
    t = re.sub(r'\s+(memory|storage|calldata)\b', '', t)
    t = ' '.join(t.split())
    base, suffixes = extract_array_suffix_simple(t)

    # Check struct
    if base in structs:
        struct_info = structs[base]
        components=[]
        for member_name, member_type in struct_info["members"]:
            comp = solidity_type_to_abi(member_type, structs, enums, contract_name)
            comp["name"]=member_name
            components.append(comp)
        internal = f"struct {contract_name}.{base}" if contract_name else f"struct {base}"
        canonical = "tuple" + ''.join(suffixes)
        internal = internal + ''.join(suffixes)
        return {"name":"", "type": canonical, "internalType": internal, "components": components, "indexed": None}

    if base in enums:
        canonical = "uint8" + ''.join(suffixes)
        internal = f"enum {contract_name}.{base}" if contract_name else f"enum {base}"
        internal = internal + ''.join(suffixes)
        return {"name":"", "type": canonical, "internalType": internal, "components": None, "indexed": None}

    # Elementary
    if base == "uint":
        canonical="uint256"
        internal="uint256"
    elif base == "int":
        canonical="int256"
        internal="int256"
    elif base == "address payable":
        canonical="address"
        internal="address payable"
    elif base == "address":
        canonical="address"
        internal="address"
    elif base in ["bool","string","bytes"] or base.startswith("uint") or base.startswith("int") or base.startswith("bytes"):
        canonical=base
        internal=base
    else:
        # Unknown user-defined, treat as is, but for ABI if it's contract type, it's address
        canonical=base
        internal=base

    canonical = canonical + ''.join(suffixes)
    internal = internal + ''.join(suffixes)
    return {"name":"", "type": canonical, "internalType": internal, "components": None, "indexed": None}

def generate_getter(sv, c_info):
    inputs=[]
    current_type = sv["type_str"]
    while True:
        trimmed = current_type.strip()
        if trimmed.startswith("mapping"):
            start = trimmed.find('(')
            end = trimmed.rfind(')')
            if start!=-1 and end!=-1:
                inner = trimmed[start+1:end]
                arrow = inner.find("=>")
                if arrow!=-1:
                    key_type = inner[:arrow].strip()
                    value_type = inner[arrow+2:].strip()
                    key_abi = solidity_type_to_abi(key_type, c_info["structs"], c_info["enums"], c_info["name"])
                    inputs.append({"name":"", "type": key_abi["type"], "internalType": key_abi["internalType"]})
                    current_type = value_type
                    continue
            break
        else:
            break
    while True:
        base, suffixes = extract_array_suffix_simple(current_type)
        if suffixes:
            for _ in suffixes:
                inputs.append({"name":"", "type":"uint256", "internalType":"uint256"})
            current_type = base
        else:
            break
    outputs=[]
    final_type = current_type.strip()
    struct_info = c_info["structs"].get(final_type)
    if struct_info:
        for member_name, member_type in struct_info["members"]:
            abi = solidity_type_to_abi(member_type, c_info["structs"], c_info["enums"], c_info["name"])
            abi["name"]=member_name
            outputs.append(abi)
    else:
        abi = solidity_type_to_abi(final_type, c_info["structs"], c_info["enums"], c_info["name"])
        abi["name"]=""
        outputs.append(abi)
    return (inputs, outputs)

    }
    idx=0
    while True:
        pos = body[idx:].find("struct")
        if pos==-1:
            break
        abs_pos=idx+pos
        if abs_pos>0 and (body[abs_pos-1].isalnum() or body[abs_pos-1]=='_'):
            idx=abs_pos+6
            continue
        after=body[abs_pos+6:]
        m = re.search(r'\s*(\w+)\s*\{', after)
        if not m:
            idx=abs_pos+6
            continue
        sname=m.group(1)
        brace_start = m.end()-1
        depth=1
        k=brace_start+1
        while k < len(after) and depth>0:
            if after[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif after[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        sbody=after[brace_start+1:k-1]
        members=[]
        for line in sbody.split(';'):
            line=line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            if ' ' in line:
                last_space = line.rfind(' ')
                mname=line[last_space+1:].strip()
                mtype=line[:last_space].strip()
                if mname.isidentifier():
                    members.append((mname,mtype))
        contract["structs"][sname] = {"name": sname, "members": members}
        idx=abs_pos+6

    idx=0
    while True:
        pos = body[idx:].find("enum")
        if pos==-1:
            break
        abs_pos=idx+pos
        if abs_pos>0 and (body[abs_pos-1].isalnum() or body[abs_pos-1]=='_'):
            idx=abs_pos+4
            continue
        after=body[abs_pos+4:]
        m = re.search(r'\s*(\w+)\s*\{', after)
        if not m:
            idx=abs_pos+4
            continue
        ename=m.group(1)
        brace_start=m.end()-1
        depth=1
        k=brace_start+1
        while k < len(after) and depth>0:
            if after[k]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif after[k]=='}':
                depth-=1
            k+=1
        ebody=after[brace_start+1:k-1]
        variants=[v.strip() for v in ebody.split(',') if v.strip()]
        contract["enums"][ename] = {"name": ename, "variants": variants}
        idx=abs_pos+4

    i=0
    blen=len(body)
    while i < blen:
        while i<blen and body[i].isspace():
            i+=1
        if i>=blen:
            break
        rem=body[i:]
        if rem.startswith("function"):
            res = parse_function_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                f,next = res
                contract["functions"].append(f)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("constructor"):
            res = parse_constructor_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                c,next = res
                contract["constructor"]=c
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("fallback"):
            res = parse_fallback_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                fb,next=res
                contract["fallback"]=fb
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("receive"):
            res = parse_receive_simple_simple(body, i)
            if res:
                rcv,next=res
                contract["receive"]=rcv
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("event"):
            res=parse_event_simple_simple(body,i)
            if res:
                ev,next=res
                contract["events"].append(ev)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("error"):
            res=parse_error_simple_simple(body,i)
            if res:
                err,next=res
                contract["errors"].append(err)
                i=next
                continue
        elif rem.startswith("struct") or rem.startswith("enum") or rem.startswith("modifier") or rem.startswith("using"):
            j=i
            found_brace=False
            while j<blen:
                if body[j]=='{':
                    found_brace=True
                    break
                if body[j]==';':
                    break
                j+=1
            if found_brace:
                depth=1
                j+=1
                while j<blen and depth>0:
                    if body[j]=='{':
                        depth+=1
                    elif body[j]=='}':
                        depth-=1
                    j+=1
                i=j
            else:
                while j<blen and body[j]!=';':
                    j+=1
                if j<blen:
                    j+=1
                i=j
            continue
        else:
            semi=find_next_semicolon(body,i)
            if semi is not None:
                line=body[i:semi+1]
                sv=parse_state_var_simple_simple(line)
                if sv:
                    contract["state_vars"].append(sv)
                i=semi+1
                continue
            else:
                break
        i+=1
    return contract

def parse_function_simple_simple(body, start):
    rem=body[start:]
    idx=len("function")
    while idx < len(rem) and rem[idx].isspace():
        idx+=1
    name_start=idx
    while idx < len(rem) and (rem[idx].isalnum() or rem[idx]=='_'):
        idx+=1
    fname = rem[name_start:idx]
    while idx < len(rem) and rem[idx].isspace():
        idx+=1
    if idx>=len(rem) or rem[idx]!='(':
        return None
    ps=idx+1
    depth=1
    j=ps
    while j < len(rem) and depth>0:
        if rem[j]=='(':
            depth+=1
        elif rem[j]==')':
            depth-=1
        j+=1
    params_str=rem[ps:j-1]
    k=j
    while k < len(rem) and rem[k].isspace():
        k+=1
    sig_end=None
    brace_pos=None
    temp=k
    pd=0
    while temp < len(rem):
        c=rem[temp]
        if c=='(':
            pd+=1
        elif c==')':
            if pd>0:
                pd-=1
        elif c=='{' and pd==0:
            sig_end=temp
            brace_pos=temp
            break
        elif c==';' and pd==0:
            sig_end=temp
            break
        temp+=1
    if sig_end is None:
        sig_end=len(rem)
    mods=rem[k:sig_end]
    vis = extract_visibility(mods) or "public"
    muta = extract_mutability(mods)
    returns_str = extract_returns(mods)
    params = parse_params(params_str)
    returns = parse_params(returns_str) if returns_str else []
    final_idx = start + sig_end
    if brace_pos is not None:
        depth=1
        p=start+brace_pos+1
        while p < len(body) and depth>0:
            if body[p]=='{':
                depth+=1
            elif body[p]=='}':
                depth-=1
            p+=1
        final_idx=p
    else:
        if final_idx < len(body) and body[final_idx]==';':
            final_idx+=1
    func = {
        "name": fname,
        "params": params,
        "returns": returns,
        "visibility": vis,
        "mutability": muta,
    }
    return (func, final_idx)

def parse_state_var_simple_simple(line):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line.endswith(';'):
        return None
    without_semi=line[:-1].strip()
    left = without_semi
    last_eq = -1
    for idx in range(len(without_semi)-1, -1, -1):
        if without_semi[idx]=='=':
            if idx+1 < len(without_semi) and without_semi[idx+1]=='>':
                continue
            last_eq = idx
            break
    if last_eq!=-1:
        left = without_semi[:last_eq].strip()
    if ' ' not in left:
        return None
    tokens = left.split()
    if not tokens:
        return None
    name_candidate = tokens[-1]
    if not name_candidate.isidentifier():
        return None
    type_and_vis = ' '.join(tokens[:-1])
    lower = type_and_vis.lower()
    vis = "internal"
    if "public" in lower:
        vis="public"
    elif "private" in lower:
        vis="private"
    type_str = type_and_vis
    for kw in [" public", " private", " internal", " external", " constant", " immutable", " virtual", " override", " transient"]:
        type_str = type_str.replace(kw, "")
    type_str = type_str.replace("override","")
    type_str = ' '.join(type_str.split())
    if not type_str:
        return None
    if "address payable" in lower and "payable" not in type_str:
        if "address" in type_str:
            type_str = type_str.replace("address", "address payable")
    return {"name": name_candidate, "type_str": type_str, "visibility": vis}

def resolve_import_py(import_path, current_file, base_path, include_paths, remappings):
    path = import_path
    sorted_remaps = sorted(remappings, key=lambda r: len(r["prefix"]), reverse=True)
    for remap in sorted_remaps:
        ctx = remap.get("context")
        if ctx:
            if not (current_file.endswith(ctx) or current_file==ctx):
                continue
        prefix = remap["prefix"]
        if path.startswith(prefix):
            rest = path[len(prefix):]
            new_path = os.path.join(remap["path"], rest)
            path = new_path
            break
    if os.path.isabs(path):
        if os.path.exists(path):
            return path
        else:
            return None
    if path.startswith("./") or path.startswith("../"):
        current_dir = "." if current_file=="<stdin>" else os.path.dirname(current_file) or "."
        resolved = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(current_dir, path))
        if os.path.exists(resolved):
            if base_path:
                abs_file = os.path.realpath(resolved)
                abs_base = os.path.realpath(base_path)
                if not abs_file.startswith(abs_base):
                    return None
            return resolved
        else:
            return None
    for inc in include_paths:
        cand = os.path.join(inc, path)
        if os.path.exists(cand):
            return cand
    if base_path:
        cand = os.path.join(base_path, path)
        if os.path.exists(cand):
            return cand
    return None
